These scripts build a small `books` database. Copy each block (use the copy
button in its top right corner) and paste it into the Dolt online SQL editor, then
run it. Run the blocks in order.

## 1. Create the table

Each book has an `id` (the primary key), a title, an author, the year it was
published, and a genre.

```sql
CREATE TABLE books (
  id int NOT NULL,
  title varchar(1023),
  author varchar(1023),
  year int,
  genre varchar(1023),
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
```

## 2. Add some classics

```sql
INSERT INTO books (id, title, author, year, genre) VALUES
(1, 'To Kill a Mockingbird', 'Harper Lee', 1960, 'Southern Gothic'),
(2, '1984', 'George Orwell', 1949, 'Dystopian'),
(3, 'Pride and Prejudice', 'Jane Austen', 1813, 'Classic'),
(4, 'The Great Gatsby', 'F. Scott Fitzgerald', 1925, 'Tragedy'),
(5, 'Moby Dick', 'Herman Melville', 1851, 'Adventure');
```

## 3. Add science fiction books

```sql
INSERT INTO books (id, title, author, year, genre) VALUES
(6, 'Dune', 'Frank Herbert', 1965, 'Science Fiction'),
(7, 'Foundation', 'Isaac Asimov', 1951, 'Science Fiction'),
(8, 'Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?', 'Philip K. Dick', 1968, 'Science Fiction'),
(9, 'A Fire Upon the Deep', 'Vernor Vinge', 1992, 'Science Fiction'),
(10, 'The Martian Chronicles', 'Ray Bradbury', 1950, 'Science Fiction');
```

## 4. Add self help books

```sql
INSERT INTO books (id, title, author, year, genre) VALUES
(11, 'The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People', 'Stephen Covey', 1989, 'Self Help'),
(12, 'Atomic Habits', 'James Clear', 2018, 'Self Help'),
(13, 'Daring Greatly', 'Brené Brown', 2012, 'Self Help'),
(14, 'Think and Grow Rich', 'Napoleon Hill', 1937, 'Self Help'),
(15, 'How to Win Friends and Influence People', 'Dale Carnegie', 1936, 'Self Help');
```

## 5. Try some queries

All the books:

```sql
SELECT * FROM books;
```

Just the science fiction, oldest first:

```sql
SELECT title, author, year
FROM books
WHERE genre = 'Science Fiction'
ORDER BY year;
```

Books published before 1950:

```sql
SELECT title, year
FROM books
WHERE year < 1950
ORDER BY year;
```

How many books are in each genre:

```sql
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS num_books
FROM books
GROUP BY genre
ORDER BY num_books DESC;
```

## Start over

To delete the table and begin again from step 1:

```sql
DROP TABLE books;
```
